method: Official complete HTML policy content extracted by scripts/prepare-real-policies-round13.py; one reviewer froze document-category labels and questions before inference; full text stays in gitignored .cache/real_policies_round13.
annotationNotes: An optional practice is affirmative when the notice says the service performs it after user choice or consent.
OpenAI explicitly describes optional device-address-book upload, user-content model training, and personalized ads for Free/Go users in the retrieved July 30, 2026 policy text.
TikTok explicitly describes optional phone-book sync, model training from information collected through the platform, and interest-based ads with consent in its November 30, 2025 EEA notice.

Biometric requires a physical or behavioral identifier used to recognize a person. TikTok's face/body detection for effects and its collection of keystroke rhythms do not explicitly affirm identity recognition; OpenAI's age/identity-verification vendor mention does not specify a biometric identifier.
